space: prop local, glTF axes: +X right, +Y up, +Z front. Origin on the ground. Same space as the prop GLB.

shapes.box: c center, h half extents, q rotation [x, y, z, w] (omitted = identity)
shapes.capsule: c center, r radius, halfHeight of the segment, along local +Y after q
shapes.cylinder: c center, r radius, halfHeight, along local +Y after q

stairs.note: one box per step, rise <= 0.22 m

roof.note: roof slabs, too steep to stand on

hedge.note: hedgerow foliage: blocks movement and sight, bullets pass
